requirements.item_text: Self-inspections are run at a set frequency written in a procedure, and at least once every year.

mappings.quote: shall be at least once in a year. The frequency shall be stated in the procedure.

requirements.item_text: Every self-inspection is documented in a report listing what was observed and, where relevant, proposed corrective actions; the actions later taken are recorded too.

mappings.quote: All self inspections should be recorded. Reports should contain all the observations made during the inspections and, where applicable, proposals for corrective measures.
A report should be made at the completion of a self-inspection.
